# AISF ARM64 模拟器 — 傻瓜手工部署指导书

> 适用：从本机 `offline-deploy/` 离线包，手工部署到 **aarch64 Linux 目标机**。  
> 原则：**不跑仓库自动化脚本**，每一步都是你自己敲的命令 / 粘贴的文件内容。

---

## 0. 先搞清楚三台机器

| 角色 | 典型信息 | 你在这台机上做什么 |
|------|----------|-------------------|
| 本机 Windows | 有 `offline-deploy/` 缓存 | 上传文件 |
| 跳板机 | 有公网 SSH | 中转（目标机通常进不来公网） |
| 目标机 | aarch64，开了 KVM | **真正安装、启动模拟器** |

约定路径：

```text
本机缓存:   .../android-emulator/aisf-voice-lab/offline-deploy
目标机目录: /root/aisf-voice-lab
账号密码:   android-emulator/华为云服务器.txt（不要提交 git）
```

目标机硬性条件：

- `uname -m` = `aarch64`
- 有 `/dev/kvm`
- root 权限
- 磁盘空余建议 ≥ 12GB

---

## 1. 核对本地离线包（本机）

确认大小正常（不是几 KB 空壳）：

```text
offline-deploy/
  emulator/
    emulator-linux_aarch64-built.tar.gz     ~391 MB   <- 必须用这个
    emu-runtime-extra.tar.gz                ~185 MB
    glibc-bundle.tar.gz                     ~2.3 MB
    linux-aarch64-deps.tar.gz               ~19 MB
  sdk/
    arm64-v8a-33_r08.zip                    ~1.5 GB
    platform-33-ext3_r03.zip
    commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip
    OpenJDK17U-jdk_aarch64_linux.tar.gz
  apk/
    aisf_arm64_signed.apk                   ~157 MB
  runtime/
    pulse-aarch64-libs.tar.gz
    mini_adb_auth.py
    libandroid-emu-metrics.so.current
    libandroid-emu-metrics.so.pre_tls_patch
```

**禁止使用：** `downloads/emulator-linux_aarch64.zip`（若只有几 KB，那是 stub）。

---

## 2. 把包传到目标机

### 2.1 本机 → 跳板（PowerShell）

```powershell
cd D:\pythonProj\MyGUITest\TestAppGUI\testApp\android-emulator\aisf-voice-lab
tar -cf offline-deploy.tar offline-deploy
scp offline-deploy.tar root@JUMP_IP:/root/
```

### 2.2 跳板 → 目标

```bash
scp -P TARGET_PORT /root/offline-deploy.tar root@TARGET_IP:/root/
```

### 2.3 目标机解包

```bash
mkdir -p /root/aisf-voice-lab
cd /root
tar -xf offline-deploy.tar
mv offline-deploy /root/aisf-voice-lab/offline-deploy
ls -lah /root/aisf-voice-lab/offline-deploy/emulator/
```

确认 `emulator-linux_aarch64-built.tar.gz` 大约 **400MB** 量级。

---

## 3. 目标机：搭目录

```bash
export LAB=/root/aisf-voice-lab
export SDK=$LAB/sdk
export EMU=$SDK/emulator
export OFF=$LAB/offline-deploy

mkdir -p "$SDK/emulator" \
         "$SDK/platform-tools" \
         "$SDK/platforms" \
         "$SDK/system-images/android-33/google_apis/arm64-v8a" \
         "$SDK/cmdline-tools" \
         "$LAB/jdk" \
         "$LAB/apk" \
         "$LAB/runs" \
         "$LAB/downloads" \
         /root/.android/avd
```

---

## 4. 安装 JDK（aarch64）

```bash
cd "$LAB/jdk"
tar -xzf "$OFF/sdk/OpenJDK17U-jdk_aarch64_linux.tar.gz"
ls "$LAB/jdk"
export JAVA_HOME=$(echo "$LAB"/jdk/jdk-17*)
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
java -version
```

---

## 5. 安装 cmdline-tools / platform / 系统镜像

### 5.1 cmdline-tools

```bash
rm -rf /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack
mkdir -p /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack
unzip -q "$OFF/sdk/commandlinetools-linux-latest.zip" -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack
mkdir -p "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest"
ls /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack
cp -a /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack/cmdline-tools/* "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/"
# if zip root is already bin/lib:
# cp -a /tmp/cmdline-tools-unpack/* "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/"
ls "$SDK/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
```

### 5.2 platform-33

```bash
unzip -q "$OFF/sdk/platform-33-ext3_r03.zip" -d "$SDK/platforms"
ls "$SDK/platforms/android-33"
```

### 5.3 系统镜像（最大，耐心等）

```bash
unzip -q "$OFF/sdk/arm64-v8a-33_r08.zip" -d "$SDK"
ls -lah "$SDK/system-images/android-33/google_apis/arm64-v8a/system.img"
```

路径不对时：`find "$SDK" -name system.img`，再手工挪到上面标准路径。

---

## 6. 手工创建 AVD（自己写配置文件）

```bash
AVD_NAME=AISF_EulerOS_ARM64
AVD_HOME=/root/.android/avd
AVD_DIR=$AVD_HOME/${AVD_NAME}.avd
mkdir -p "$AVD_DIR"

cat > "$AVD_HOME/${AVD_NAME}.ini" <<'EOF'
avd.ini.displayname=AISF_EulerOS_ARM64
avd.ini.encoding=UTF-8
path=/root/.android/avd/AISF_EulerOS_ARM64.avd
path.rel=avd/AISF_EulerOS_ARM64.avd
target=android-33
EOF

cat > "$AVD_DIR/config.ini" <<'EOF'
AvdId=AISF_EulerOS_ARM64
PlayStore.enabled=false
abi.type=arm64-v8a
avd.ini.displayname=AISF_EulerOS_ARM64
avd.ini.encoding=UTF-8
disk.dataPartition.size=6G
hw.cpu.arch=arm64
hw.cpu.ncore=4
hw.ramSize=4096
hw.gpu.enabled=yes
hw.gpu.mode=swiftshader_indirect
image.sysdir.1=system-images/android-33/google_apis/arm64-v8a/
tag.display=Google APIs
tag.id=google_apis
vm.heapSize=256
quickbootChoice=no
EOF
```

```bash
test -f "$SDK/system-images/android-33/google_apis/arm64-v8a/system.img" && echo SYS_OK
```

---

## 7. 安装模拟器 + glibc + metrics

### 7.1 模拟器本体

```bash
tar -xzf "$OFF/emulator/emulator-linux_aarch64-built.tar.gz" -C "$SDK"
ls -lah "$EMU/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless"
file "$EMU/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless"
```

### 7.2 glibc 捆绑库

```bash
mkdir -p "$EMU/lib64/glibc"
tar -xzf "$OFF/emulator/glibc-bundle.tar.gz" -C "$EMU/lib64/glibc"
ls "$EMU/lib64/glibc/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1"
ls "$EMU/lib64/glibc/lib/libc.so.6"
```

### 7.3 运行时附件

```bash
tar -tzf "$OFF/emulator/emu-runtime-extra.tar.gz" | head -30
tar -xzf "$OFF/emulator/emu-runtime-extra.tar.gz" -C "$EMU"
```

### 7.4 metrics 库

```bash
cp -a "$OFF/runtime/libandroid-emu-metrics.so.current" \
      "$EMU/lib64/libandroid-emu-metrics.so"
cp -a "$OFF/runtime/libandroid-emu-metrics.so.pre_tls_patch" \
      "$EMU/lib64/libandroid-emu-metrics.so.pre_tls_patch"
chmod 755 "$EMU/lib64/libandroid-emu-metrics.so"
```

---

## 8. 准备 patchelf

```bash
yum install -y patchelf || dnf install -y patchelf
which patchelf
patchelf --version
```

没有源就从跳板拷一个 **aarch64** 的 `patchelf` 到 `/usr/local/bin/`。

---

## 9. 关键步骤：改 qemu（顺序绝不能反）

```bash
QEMU="$EMU/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless"
LD="$EMU/lib64/glibc/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1"
RP="$EMU/lib64/glibc/lib:$EMU/lib64/gles_swiftshader:$EMU/lib64/vulkan:$EMU/lib64:/usr/lib64"
```

### 9.1 备份

```bash
cp -a "$QEMU" "$QEMU.bak"
```

### 9.2 第一步：patchelf（必须先做）

```bash
cp -f "$QEMU.bak" "$QEMU"
chmod u+w "$QEMU"

patchelf --force-rpath \
  --set-interpreter "$LD" \
  --set-rpath "$RP" \
  "$QEMU"

patchelf --print-interpreter "$QEMU"
patchelf --print-rpath "$QEMU"
```

interpreter 必须指向 `.../lib64/glibc/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1`。

**绝对不要**把 bundled glibc 写进 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`。

缺 libX11 时再做：

```bash
ln -sfn /usr/lib64/libX11.so.6 "$EMU/lib64/libX11.so.6"
ln -sfn /usr/lib64/libX11.so.6 "$EMU/lib64/libX11.so"
```

清掉误放进 lib64 的系统 libc（若有）：

```bash
rm -f "$EMU/lib64/libc.so.6" "$EMU/lib64/libm.so.6" "$EMU/lib64/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1"
```

### 9.3 第二步：virtio 指令补丁（必须在 patchelf 之后）

在目标机粘贴执行（cbz -> 无条件 b）：

```bash
python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct

qemu = Path("/root/aisf-voice-lab/sdk/emulator/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless")
data = bytearray(qemu.read_bytes())

va = 0x5FEA04
orig = struct.pack("<I", 0xB4000BC0)  # cbz x0, +0x178
new  = struct.pack("<I", 0x1400005E)  # b +0x178

e_phoff = struct.unpack_from("<Q", data, 32)[0]
e_phentsize = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 54)[0]
e_phnum = struct.unpack_from("<H", data, 56)[0]
file_off = None
for i in range(e_phnum):
    off = e_phoff + i * e_phentsize
    p_type = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off)[0]
    p_offset, p_vaddr, _, _, p_memsz, _ = struct.unpack_from("<QQQQQQ", data, off + 8)
    if p_type == 1 and p_vaddr <= va < p_vaddr + p_memsz:
        file_off = p_offset + (va - p_vaddr)
        break
assert file_off is not None, "VA not in PT_LOAD"
cur = bytes(data[file_off:file_off+4])
print("file_off", hex(file_off), "cur", cur.hex())
if cur == new:
    print("already patched")
elif cur == orig:
    data[file_off:file_off+4] = new
    qemu.write_bytes(data)
    print("patched OK")
else:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected insn %s, abort" % cur.hex())
print("after", qemu.read_bytes()[file_off:file_off+4].hex())
PY
```

看到 `patched OK` / `already patched` 再继续。若 `cur` 不匹配：**停手**。

### 9.4 手写 emulator 包装（必须 unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH）

```bash
cat > "$EMU/emulator" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
export ANDROID_EMU_ROOT="$DIR"
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$(cd "$DIR/.." && pwd)}"
export ANDROID_EMU_DISABLE_VULKAN=1
export ANDROID_EMU_ENABLE_CRASH_REPORTING=0
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH
unset LD_PRELOAD
exec "$DIR/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless" "$@"
EOF
chmod +x "$EMU/emulator"

printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'exit 0' > "$EMU/crashpad_handler"
chmod 755 "$EMU/crashpad_handler"
```

### 9.5 冒烟

```bash
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK"
export ANDROID_EMU_ROOT="$EMU"
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
"$EMU/emulator" -version | head -5
```

应有 `Android emulator version`，且没有 `GLIBC_... not found`。

---

## 10. PulseAudio 虚拟麦克风（测语音才需要）

```bash
yum install -y pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils || true

mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-a64
tar -xzf "$OFF/runtime/pulse-aarch64-libs.tar.gz" -C /tmp/pulse-a64
cp -a /tmp/pulse-a64/lib*.so* /usr/local/lib64/
echo /usr/local/lib64 > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/local64.conf
ldconfig

export PULSE_RUNTIME_PATH=/tmp/pulse-root
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/tmp/pulse-root
mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-root
chmod 700 /tmp/pulse-root
pulseaudio -k 2>/dev/null || true
pulseaudio -D --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-target=file:/tmp/pulseaudio.log
pactl info | head

pactl load-module module-null-sink sink_name=VirtualMic sink_properties=device.description=VirtualMic
pactl set-default-source VirtualMic.monitor
```

---

## 11. 安装 mini_adb（顶替会崩的官方 adb）

```bash
cp -a "$OFF/runtime/mini_adb_auth.py" "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py"
chmod +x "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py"

mkdir -p "$SDK/platform-tools"
cat > "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" <<EOF
#!/bin/bash
exec python3 $LAB/mini_adb_auth.py "\$@"
EOF
chmod +x "$SDK/platform-tools/adb"
export PATH="$SDK/platform-tools:$EMU:$PATH"
```

也可直接：

```bash
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" devices
```

---

## 12. 启动模拟器

```bash
export LAB=/root/aisf-voice-lab
export SDK=$LAB/sdk
export EMU=$SDK/emulator
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$SDK
export ANDROID_EMU_ROOT=$EMU
export PATH="$EMU:$SDK/platform-tools:$PATH"
export HOME=/root
unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD

chmod 666 /dev/kvm 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p "$LAB/runs"

QEMU="$EMU/qemu/linux-aarch64/qemu-system-aarch64-headless"
for pid in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  exe=$(readlink -f "$pid/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ "$exe" = "$QEMU" ] && kill -9 "${pid#/proc/}"
done

# 语音场景：不要加 -audio none
# 无公网时加： -http-proxy http://127.0.0.1:8888
nohup "$EMU/emulator" \
  -avd AISF_EulerOS_ARM64 \
  -no-window \
  -no-snapshot \
  -no-snapshot-load \
  -no-snapshot-save \
  -gpu swiftshader_indirect \
  -no-boot-anim \
  -no-metrics \
  -feature -Vulkan \
  >>"$LAB/runs/emulator.log" 2>&1 &

echo "PID=$!"
sleep 5
tail -30 "$LAB/runs/emulator.log"
```

等启动（常要 2~5 分钟）：

```bash
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" wait-for-device
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" shell getprop sys.boot_completed
# 期望输出：1
```

---

## 13. 安装 AISF APK

```bash
cp -a "$OFF/apk/aisf_arm64_signed.apk" "$LAB/apk/"
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" install -r "$LAB/apk/aisf_arm64_signed.apk"
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" shell pm path com.huawei.aisftvassistant
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" shell am start -n \
  com.huawei.aisftvassistant/.activity.PhoneLaunchActivity
```

---

## 14. （可选）目标无公网时的代理

1. 跳板开 HTTP CONNECT 代理，监听 `8888`
2. SSH 反弹：`ssh -R 127.0.0.1:8888:127.0.0.1:8888 ...`
3. 模拟器加：`-http-proxy http://127.0.0.1:8888`
4. 必要时 guest hosts 处理 `auth.dui.ai`

---

## 15. （可选）语音注入冒烟

```bash
python3 "$LAB/mini_adb_auth.py" emu avd hostmicon
paplay --device=VirtualMic /path/to/weather_question.wav
```

应用登录成功 ≠ DDS 语音鉴权成功。云端 `401` / `Invalid api key` 是 DDS 凭证问题，不是模拟器没装好。

---

## 16. 验收清单

| # | 检查项 | 期望 |
|---|--------|------|
| 1 | `uname -m` | `aarch64` |
| 2 | qemu size | hundreds of MB |
| 3 | `patchelf --print-interpreter` | bundled ld path |
| 4 | virtio patch site | insn `1400005e` |
| 5 | `emulator -version` | version, no GLIBC not found |
| 6 | wrapper | has `unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH` |
| 7 | `sys.boot_completed` | `1` |
| 8 | `pm path com.huawei.aisftvassistant` | has path |

---

## 17. 铁律

1. 只用 `emulator-linux_aarch64-built.tar.gz`，不用 stub zip。
2. **先** patchelf，**后** virtio 补丁。
3. wrapper 必须 `unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH`；禁止把 bundled glibc 放进 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`。
4. 启动带：`-no-snapshot -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save`。
5. 测语音不要加 `-audio none`。
6. 官方 aarch64 adb 可能 abort → 用 `mini_adb_auth.py`。
7. APK 必须是 arm64-v8a 的 `aisf_arm64_signed.apk`。

---

## 18. 常见现象

| 现象 | 先查 |
|------|------|
| `GLIBC_2.38 not found` | patchelf / interpreter |
| qemu instant exit | patchelf then CBZ order; `runs/emulator.log` |
| adb fail | mini_adb; port 5555; kill old qemu cold boot |
| `INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS` | wrong APK ABI |
| boot_completed empty | wait; system.img vs AVD path |
| voice 401 | DDS cloud credentials |

---

下次换机：把 `offline-deploy/` 再传一遍，从第 3 章做起即可（不必重新交叉编译）。
